create_ShortCycleBatchSampler: create a ShortCycleBatchSampler instance with a base sampler, batch size, drop_last flag, and config for multigrid short-cycle training
test_ShortCycleBatchSampler_iter: test the ShortCycleBatchSampler __iter__ method to yield batches cycling through three batch sizes
test_ShortCycleBatchSampler_len: test the ShortCycleBatchSampler __len__ method to return the number of batches based on average batch size
review_ShortCycleBatchSampler_init: review the ShortCycleBatchSampler __init__ method to validate sampler, batch_size, drop_last inputs and compute batch sizes from multigrid config
build_multigrid_batch_sampling: build a multigrid short-cycle batch sampler that alternates between larger and standard batch sizes during video model training
